integrity: A complete self-contained proof and executable finite test suite are supplied. Only same-model review has been performed; independent examination has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The decomposition is asserted only for finite connected triangle-free simple graphs without K2,3 subgraphs; it does not determine X_G itself or Čech complexes at other scales. Universal proof is mathematical, finite experiments corroborate it.
title: Square-cell splitting for closed neighborhood complexes of triangle-free graphs
